resources.string: Rate a hit with "Bewerten" and SSI learns locally (resettable). Under Settings → SSI-Suche → Benchmark you import your own test examples and measure how often the right moment is among the first hits.

In the editor of "Eigenes", select an element and open the tab "Animation": presets in a few taps, all parameters and springs in advanced mode, timeline and curve editor in pro mode, plus states such as pressed or loading.
